summary_en: Introduces OpenQPAIData, an experimentally grounded benchmark for quantitative photoacoustic imaging containing 30 tissue-mimicking phantoms measured on three PA systems. The release includes raw measurements, reconstructions, manual reference annotations, and independently measured optical-property maps, enabling end-to-end validation of acoustic reconstruction and optical inversion algorithms.

summary_en: Presents PhotIQA, a benchmark of 1,134 photoacoustic images with expert ratings across overall quality, edge visibility, homogeneity, inclusion intensity, and background intensity. The dataset targets a persistent evaluation gap in photoacoustic reconstruction, where both acoustic and optical inverse-problem artifacts can confound conventional natural-image quality metrics.

summary_en: Introduces a miniaturized polymer resonator fabricated on a tapered single-mode optical-fiber tip for broadband optical ultrasound detection in optoacoustic mesoscopy. The 6-micrometer cavity delivers roughly 150 MHz bandwidth and about 1.5 mPa Hz^-1/2 noise-equivalent pressure density, with high-resolution imaging and reduced surface-acoustic-wave artifacts validated in vivo.

summary_en: Evaluates a handheld ultrasound-guided multi-wavelength photoacoustic tomography workflow for ex-vivo breast surgical-margin assessment. Across 53 specimens, photoacoustic maps of lipid, hemoglobin, and collagen are compared with histopathology, providing a clinically oriented demonstration of co-registered acoustic-optical imaging for intraoperative decision support.
